title: Ordinary tensor inverse image normalized by its adjoint sections
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y and f:X→Y, Base b and Geometry g [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. Let tensorRight(N) be the actual sheafified tensor functor on the ringed sequence site, and tensorPure its sheafification-unit pairing. Define TensorPullback(g) to consist, for each ordinary coefficient system N, of a natural isomorphism tensorRight(N) followed by g.pull ≅ g.pull followed by tensorRight(g.pull N). Its ordinary adjoint on every finite chart sends a pure x tensor y to the pure tensor of the two ordinary adjunction-unit sections [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. This data involves no Chern object, line, twisting, projective model, or projection.
